text:
nolan: Heads-up: assembling release notes + changelog for docs v0.12. Focus areas: migration guide for embed-streaming removal, SDK snippet parity (JS/Py), small examples cleanup, and a short known-issues section. Who can shepherd publish? ping @maya

maya: I can own publish and the final blurb. Freeze PRs by Wed 3pm PT. Drop PR links and any copy-snippet concerns here. :white_check_mark:

ria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5377 -- migration guide + sample diffs. Note: I removed numeric perf claims and replaced with generic "expected lower latency" phrasing.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5391 -- JS and Python examples updated. Replaced `client.generate()` with `client.text.generate()` and `rdw.text.generate()` as discussed. Left short MIGRATE note in each snippet.

kyle: Quick tech check: routing fallback change needs a concise behavioral-change bullet in the changelog. Draft: "Routing fallback now prefers lower-latency compatible model variants; this can change per-request results and tail-latency profiles." Happy to paste exact wording into changelog PR.

maya: Please paste, kyle. Also add a tiny YAML example comparing policy values, something like:
```yaml
route_policy:
  policy: latency
# vs
  policy: cost
```

ria: Fixed a broken anchor to /docs/perf/caching#kv-cache and updated an internal redirect. Also found one page still using `kestrel:openai/compat` in an example; switched to canonical model spec.

nolan: Known-issues draft bullets: - Sidebar anchor cache can surface stale anchors briefly after deploy; Netlify cache-bust usually fixes. - embed-streaming removed: users on older integrations should migrate to embeddings.v2 or request support for Dedicated capacity. - Python SDK alias warning: `client.generate` is deprecated — use `client.text.generate`. Keep bullets short.

docs-bot: Release checklist: 1) All PR links posted 2) Snippets smoke-tested 3) Changelog entry added to /changelogs/0.12.md 4) Known-issues block included 5) Owner runs `/docs release-ready` to trigger publish.

sam: ✅ snippet tested (JS + Py) -- ran locally, no runtime errors. Removed sample token counts from outputs.

maya: I’ll assemble the changelog blurb and open a docs PR for /changelogs/0.12.md by Tue EOD. If you push fixes after freeze, add a one-line note to the PR describing the change so I can incorporate into release notes.

kyle: Small ops note: if we see anchor 404 reports post-merge, I can trigger a short Netlify cache invalidation.

nolan: Cool. Final draft due Wed 2pm PT so I can run a quick pass before publish. Thanks all. :rocket:
